text:
sam (support): Customer acme-corp (tenant: acme-88) reports console missing usage rows for the last ~6 hours. Dashboard hourly chart shows 0 rows after 2026-03-16T02:00Z. Customer worried about billing. Repro steps below and tenant link sent.

jordan (sre): Copy — any recent ETL/connector deploys around 02:00Z? @maria can you check consumer lag and CDC?

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: analytics-etl v3.2.1 deployed by maria at 2026-03-16T01:57:12 UTC (sha: a1b2c3d)

maria (eng-infra): I rolled v3.2.1 then. Jobs looked OK initially but I see a lag spike in the hourly consumer at ~2026-03-16T02:04Z.

maria (eng-infra): Quick checks:
```bash
# check consumer lag
kafka-consumer-groups.sh --bootstrap-server kafka.prod:9092 --describe --group analytics-hourly
```
log snippet: "WARN consumer-lag: partitions 0-7 lag=1,200,432 msgs @ 2026-03-16T02:04:37Z"

lee (product-analytics): Customer-facing impact: console shows "0 rows" for hours 02:00-08:00. They tried manual refresh and it didn't help. This affects billing visibility.

sam (support): I asked them to share a screenshot and confirmed tenant id. They confirmed manual refresh didn't change anything.

jordan (sre): Can someone run a quick DB check to confirm latest rollup hour for that tenant?

maria (eng-infra): Ran quick query:
```sql
SELECT tenant_id, max(hour) FROM hourly_rollups WHERE tenant_id='acme-88' GROUP BY tenant_id;
-- returns: acme-88 | 2026-03-16 02:00:00+00
```
So DB shows last hour at 02:00Z indeed.

maria (eng-infra): Found connector errors in CDC logs around 02:03Z: 
"ERROR avro-deserialize: schema registry error: field 'customer_plan' not found in schema v12"
Looks like an upstream Avro schema change that caused the CDC consumer to drop messages briefly, which created the consumer lag.

jordan (sre): That matches the lag spike. Short-term mitigation: restart connector/consumer and run a targeted backfill for the missing window.

maria (eng-infra): Proposed runbook:
1) Restart CDC connector: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/cdc-ingest`
2) Restart hourly consumer: `kubectl -n analytics rollout restart deployment/analytics-hourly-consumer`
3) Run backfill for tenant: `python tools/backfill_usage.py --tenant acme-88 --start 2026-03-16T02:00:00Z --end 2026-03-16T08:00:00Z`
4) Monitor consumer lag and DB writes; post progress here.

sam (support): Customer consented to backfill and restart. Asked for ETA.

maria (eng-infra): Backfill ETA ~20-30m depending on throughput. Kicking off step 1-2 now. I'll post when backfill starts.

maria (eng-infra): Backfill started at 2026-03-16T03:12:05Z. Running with batch size 1000.

maria (eng-infra): Progress update: processed 3/6 hours, no deserialization errors after connector restart. Writes to hourly_rollups progressing.

jordan (sre): Good. Opening short incident note (analytics-ingest) and paging oncall in case of recurrence.

sam (support): I'll update customer with ETA and offer CSV export of interim usage so billing isn't blocked. :thumbsup:

lee (product-analytics): After backfill completes, can we run a diff job to ensure no duplicates and validate totals vs raw events? Recommend a small checksum script.

maria (eng-infra): Agreed — we run dedupe-check and totals compare after backfill.

sam (support): Customer acknowledged, appreciates quick response. I'll mark as escalated -> eng-infra and follow up when rows appear in console.

maria (eng-infra): Backfill finished at 2026-03-16T03:38:47Z. Verified hourly_rollups now show up to 2026-03-16T08:00:00+00 for acme-88. Ran dedupe-check, no duplicates.

sam (support): Confirmed with customer: rows are visible, dashboard updated, they confirmed billing view restored. Closing loop. Thanks team. :tada:
